What stays editorial

Scores and reviews aren't for sale

Partner placement changes where your product appears in a category list. It doesn't change your score, our review or what we write about competitors. Every review carries a disclosure that partner compensation may affect which products we include and where they appear.

Listings are reviewed by our editors before they go live. We may edit descriptions for accuracy and decline products that don't fit a category. See the advertiser terms.

FAQ

Where will my product appear?

In the position you reserve (1st, 2nd or 3rd) on the shortlist for your category, in the review cards and in the comparison table, with a link to your landing page.

What if the position I want is taken?

Join its waitlist. When the current holder doesn't renew, the first vendor on the waitlist gets 72 hours to claim it before it opens to everyone.

How do I pay?

Each reservation and renewal creates an invoice for one month. Your position goes live, or is extended by a month, when the invoice is paid. If you don't renew, the position ends at the end of the paid month.

Can I see results?

Yes. Your dashboard shows impressions and visits to your site per day and per listing, with a CSV export. Add UTM parameters to your landing page to see conversions in your own analytics.

Do I need to be on Vettlo's shortlist already?

No. If we've scored your product, your existing review card moves up. If we haven't, your listing appears with the details you provide, marked as not yet scored.
